Clear terms from the start

  • Paid campaigns: 50% before production and 50% after delivery or publication, as agreed.
  • Usage rights, paid advertising, exclusivity and raw footage are quoted separately.
  • Factual review and editorial independence are agreed before production.
  • Paid content and affiliate relationships are disclosed.
